scope.purpose: Incoming other/melee/projectile/explosion damage completes all requirements, invokes reward and revokes criteria; outgoing other damage does not grant type-other.
scope.fixture: Explicit first_join; marker damage source has all 16 FindFlag zero bits. The marker intentionally does not enter living-Mob damage routing. Damage command creates real advancement events. Outgoing attacker carries AttackedByApi to exclude unrelated attack routing. Advance 100 ticks after login before the first hit; 20 ticks between later hits.

steps.name: Explicit player initialization in frozen test world
commands: execute as VerifyHurt at @s run function core:handler/first_join

steps.name: Source fixture supplies all FindFlag bits without a living Mob
Advance 100 ticks after login before first damage
other completes reward from fresh criteria
commands: execute if score VerifyHurt InBattleTick matches 160 unless entity @a[name=VerifyHurt,advancements={mob_manager:entity_finder/check_entity_hurt_player={type-other=true}}] run scoreboard players set OTHER HurtVerify 1

steps.name: melee completes reward from fresh criteria
commands: execute if score VerifyHurt InBattleTick matches 160 unless entity @a[name=VerifyHurt,advancements={mob_manager:entity_finder/check_entity_hurt_player={type-melee=true}}] run scoreboard players set MELEE HurtVerify 1

steps.name: projectile completes reward from fresh criteria
commands: execute if score VerifyHurt InBattleTick matches 160 unless entity @a[name=VerifyHurt,advancements={mob_manager:entity_finder/check_entity_hurt_player={type-projectile=true}}] run scoreboard players set PROJECTILE HurtVerify 1

steps.name: explosion completes reward from fresh criteria
commands: execute if score VerifyHurt InBattleTick matches 160 unless entity @a[name=VerifyHurt,advancements={mob_manager:entity_finder/check_entity_hurt_player={type-explosion=true}}] run scoreboard players set EXPLOSION HurtVerify 1

steps.name: Outgoing other damage does not grant the incoming criterion
commands: execute if score VerifyHurt InBattleTick matches 0 unless entity @a[name=VerifyHurt,advancements={mob_manager:entity_finder/check_entity_hurt_player={type-other=true}}] run scoreboard players set OUTGOING HurtVerify 1
